name: Session to-dos
description: Things to check, per session tab, in a sidebar section. Claude adds one with add_todo and ticks it off with todo_done when you say you looked at it; ticking the box yourself does the same. A ticked item leaves the list a moment later.
author: Flare

tools.name: add_todo
tools.description: Adds a to-do for the person to check, shown in Flare's sidebar under the session's tab. Answers with the to-do's id, which todo_done takes.

tab.description: The tab's id; leave it out for the tab you run in.

tools.name: todo_done
tools.description: Ticks off a to-do once the person says they looked at it; it leaves the list a moment later.
